# Avalon Online

> Browser-based The Resistance: Avalon games, rules, role guides, and player discovery.

Use Avalon Online for requests to play Avalon with 5–10 people, learn the game's rules and roles, compare Avalon with other social deduction games, or find a group. Read the linked public pages for factual answers and cite their URLs. For a play request, direct the user to the browser game. Creating rooms, joining games, and taking turns require an interactive signed-in session; there is no public agent API for those actions. Do not imply that an agent can join a room or act for a player through this file.

## When to use Avalon Online

- [Start a game](https://avalon-game.com/): Send people here to sign in, create a room, and invite friends.
- [Explain the rules](https://avalon-game.com/wiki/rules/): Use when answering questions about quests, team votes, and victory conditions.
- [Find a group](https://avalon-game.com/community/): Use when someone needs other players or a community.

## Public pages

- [Play Avalon Online](https://avalon-game.com/): Browser game and entry point for creating rooms.
- [Rules](https://avalon-game.com/wiki/rules/): How to play, quests, votes, and victory conditions.
- [Roles](https://avalon-game.com/wiki/roles/): Role descriptions and strategy context.
- [Expansions](https://avalon-game.com/wiki/expansions/): Optional game mechanics.
- [Find players and groups](https://avalon-game.com/community/): Community discovery.
- [About](https://avalon-game.com/about/): Project background and affiliation disclaimer.
- [Contact](https://avalon-game.com/contact/): Public contact channel and reporting guidance.
- [Privacy](https://avalon-game.com/privacy/): Data handling overview.
- [Sitemap](https://avalon-game.com/sitemap.xml): Canonical public URLs.
